summary: In February 2024, Gilroy City Councilmember Tom Cline voted no on a Gaza ceasefire resolution and seconded a motion to reject any and all ceasefire resolutions at the same council meeting. The Mercury News reported the council's rejection. His seconding of the broader, blanket-rejection motion places him beyond a single no vote on one measure.
